title: Governance Lifecycle
alt: The governance lifecycle spans context compilation, policy resolution, and verification gating.
text: Boxes: AGENTS.md (Canonical Source), praetorctl compile-context, .standards.yaml (& .standards.lock), Effective Policy (Lattice Supremum), .devcontainer & Toolchain, praetorctl audit, praetorctl plan, praetorctl gate run, Gate stages, Ed25519 Exit-0 receipt.
praetorctl gate run → Gate stages → Ed25519 Exit-0 receipt.
Scenario 1, compile-context: AGENTS.md is transpiled to vendor-specific files. The single source of truth is read. Target-specific files are generated.

Scenario 2, policy: The lattice resolves standard definitions into effective policy. Manifest and lockfile are merged. Policy applies to the devcontainer toolchain, audit enforcement, and plan previews.
Scenario 3, gate run: praetorctl gate run executes the gated pipeline. The gate command triggers the verification cascade. A successful run mints a signed receipt.
